'''Foul Flesh''' is a {{Rare}} item that is an {{Odds|occasional|no=y}} drop from the [[Revenant Horror]].

== Obtaining ==
'''Foul Flesh''' is a {{O|occ|no=y}} drop from {{SlayerTier|II}}, {{SlayerTier|III}}, {{SlayerTier|IV}} and {{SlayerTier|V}} [[Revenant Horror]]s.

;Drop Chances
*{{SlayerTier|II|romanonly=1}}: 16.16% (1x)
*{{SlayerTier|III|romanonly=1}}: 16.08% (1-2x)
*{{SlayerTier|IV|romanonly=1}}: 16.22% (2-3x)
*{{SlayerTier|V|romanonly=1}}: 13.77% (3-4x)

== Usage ==
=== Minion Fuel ===
'''Foul Flesh''' can be used as a fuel source for [[Minions]]. It increases the efficiency by {{Green|90%}} for {{Green|5h}}. {{Affected Minions List|fuel|all}}

=== Brewing ===
It can be used as an ingredient to produce a {{PotN|Stamina|sp=y}} from [[Awkward Potion]]s. Stamina Potions provide {{hp|+150}} and +50 {{stat|mana}} at level 1.

{{Brewing Stand
|Input = Foul Flesh
|Output1 = Stamina Potion
|Output2 = Stamina Potion
|Output3 = Stamina Potion
}}

=== Abiphone Contact ===
{{NPCSprite|Fred}} can be given a {{Green|64x}} '''Foul Flesh''' in exchange for their [[Abiphone]] contact.

== Tips ==
*While there are more cost efficient fuels, '''Foul Flesh''' has the highest minion speed boost of all fuels. So if a player wants to collect generated resources manually, this can be their go to option.
